messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - canary cluster 'canary-v2' reporting SIGTERM cascade on multiple replicas, 40% 5xx, latency spike. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-evac
oncall-bot: @dmitri you're on-call (primary). Escalation in 2m if no ack. :rotating_light:
dmitri: Acked. Joining. Pulling logs now.
alice: Seeing repeated SIGTERM in pod logs, then kubelet restart loop on canary-3/5. Could be host-level eviction or cgroup OOM. Quick grep: `/var/log/containers/canary-*.log` shows process exit 143.
dmitri: Running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep canary-v2` to identify affected nodes.
carla: FYI customer support: a few enterprise customers reported slow generation and truncated responses ~10:32 PST. Ticket #INC-7839 opened.
dmitri: Starting manual rollback to stable model variant for canary route. Command: `redwood ctl rollout revert --service inference-canary --to-tag stable-2026-11-02 --reason "SIGTERM cascade"`
alice: Also flipping canary feature flag to stop additional traffic: `/flags set inference.canary_send false` (I have console access).
sre-lead: Good. Start traffic drain to stable and pause automated rollouts. Notify runtime.
incident-bot: Runbook step: drain traffic -> revert -> smoke tests. Posting checklist.
dmitri: Drain initiated. Current traffic shift: 70% -> stable, 30% residual.
alice: kube events show node evictions on host-ip-10-2-7-21, causes: out-of-memory-killer. Noted heavy prefetching processes on those hosts.
carla: Customer impact update: most tickets marked partial degradation, no data loss. Will update stakeholders after smoke checks.
dmitri: Rollback completed on control plane. Confirming service versions: `redwood ctl status --service inference-canary` -> now serving stable-2026-11-02 on all routable endpoints.
oncall-bot: Automated smoke checks running (10 probes). Progress: 7/10 passed.
dmitri: Manual smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck"}' | jq .status` -> returns "ok" on 3 test tokens. Latency 120ms -> previously 1.2s.
alice: KV cache warm-up in progress. Early latency numbers look good: p50 ~45ms, p95 ~210ms.
eve: Should we keep the feature flag off and keep rollback?
sre-lead: Yes — hold rollback. We'll keep traffic on stable until runtime team fixes eviction/root cause. Open follow-up ticket for runtime + infra.
dmitri: Created ENG-IR-1287 for runtime investigation, assigning to @runtime-team. Adding logs and node IDs.
carla: Notifying affected customers with temporary degraded service note and mitigation summary.
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated. Postmortem owner assigned: @sre-lead. Please fill out RCA template.
sre-lead: Handing over to eng-runtime for root cause and permanent fix. On-call remains available for verification.
oncall-bot: Incident resolved. If latency or 5xx spike returns, page primary on-call. :white_check_mark:
